instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Archicad graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, or PowerShell; do not run Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, Archicad API, scripts, macros, or any helper automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Archicad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, palettes, element settings, and built-in save/export commands. Gallery Pavilion. Start from a blank Archicad project with no init files or local reference images. Build or edit the model using real Archicad BIM elements: Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, Stairs, Columns, Beams, or Curtain Walls where required. Do not use visual-only Morphs, objects, meshes, or generic proxy placeholders as substitutes for the required BIM elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Archicad's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. Create a single-storey gallery pavilion with five Zones named FOYER, GALLERY, STORE, WC, and OFFICE. Use a simple rectangular or L-shaped plan with internal partitions, one main public gallery, support rooms, a floor slab, a simple roof, exterior doors, internal doors, and several windows. The exported IFC must contain exactly 5 Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named FOYER, GALLERY, STORE, WC, OFFICE. It must contain exactly 1 building storey; at least 10 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements; at least 1 IfcSlab element; at least 1 IfcRoof element; at least 4 IfcDoor elements; at least 4 IfcWindow elements. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 12 m, Y span 8 m, and Z span 3.6 m. Keep the model simple enough to complete manually in Archicad: rectangular or orthogonal rooms, ordinary straight walls, standard door/window tools, simple slab and roof elements, and only the listed structural or glazed elements where requested. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects and should not contain IfcBuildingElementProxy objects as substitutes for required spaces, walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, windows, columns, beams, or curtain walls. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content and approximate overall size.
